items.title: James "Sing" Miller Interview, 1971-01-17
items.q: Well, they got a boy named Lapp.

ctx.x: When fellas come out there and the boys see him and move this hill. Yeah. I'll get us up and you know.

Well, they got a boy named Lapp. He come there with a green truck. See, when I was standing back in the house room, I had control of my dog. But this boy, he comes right there. He works at Canarybury. And every day around 12 o'clock, 11 o'clock, he come there with fresh meat, you know, bones, you know, and feed my dog. Since then I ain't been able to do that with my dog. Oh, that's the other dog.
That's the big dog, you see.
